plain: Inside the CIA there was a secret matter handled so tightly that nothing about it was written into any record, according to a former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, who says he took part. He tells Michels this was "very highly unusual, irregular I'd call it," since the agency normally records its work, which would mean some subjects leave no paper trail at all.
